title: 1987 losing target pin
body:
Fixes #1987 

Well, it actually introduces a workaround.

The issue is that GeoMan registers a new `onCreate` method on each re-rendering.

I don't know if the issue is in GeoMan or `react-leaflet-geoman`

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/199016165-276211f0-e363-4a4c-8da1-285f55ef2956.png)

issues.title: Complex steps end up breaking activity (Precision Strike)
issues.body:
The more steps I include in a Precision strike, the higher the chances of the feature missing the target pin and route out: 

[eef1e8da-497e-448e-9835-187a0ae8edd4.webm](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/198852203-b67413e9-e244-463a-b87f-afab51a9700b.webm)

P.S. Notice that the Precision Strike shows as Land Activity.
